title: Application of dual-tree complex wavelet transform for spectra background reduction
summary: This paper presents a method for background removal in experimental data processing using the Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Transform (DTCWT). The technique is based on discrete wavelet theory (DWT) and addresses limitations of commonly used numerical approaches, such as fitting or filtering methods. Compared with Fourier-transform-based techniques, DTCWT provides improved performance for signal extraction.
